criteria.name: Hook strength
criteria.notes: First ~210 chars stand alone, name the mechanism (the fuel gate) and the news trigger (June 23 Alaska Energy, RCA cost-inflation quote verbatim), signal the reframe without snark.

criteria.name: Mechanism load-bearing + AK consequence
criteria.notes: Mechanism gates AK data-center siting; concrete consequence (facilities/power; DAF 4,700-acre JBER/Eielson/Clear + Chugach; firm-fuel gating milestone; first gas 2028-2029).

criteria.name: Layer fidelity
criteria.notes: All five body layers appear in dossier layers[] with matching controlling actors. No invented layers.

criteria.name: Chokepoint clarity
criteria.notes: Names the RCA cost-allocation/cross-subsidization gate, RCA, and a 3-2 docketed approve/deny. Held to 7 because the actor is a five-member commission, the weaker single-actor form.

criteria.name: Structural read
criteria.notes: Honest grounded position (depletion converts Railbelt fuel into a natural-monopoly build, RCA reprices the AI-power question). Proportionate, not snark.

criteria.name: Forward implication
criteria.notes: Concrete this-week read with dated window. Short of 10 because it does not name which competing developer is positioned.

criteria.name: Primary-source quality
criteria.notes: Chokepoint layer traces to primary statute AS 42.05.141; other four layers on credible re-fetched journalism because agency primaries were host-blocked. Descriptor-7 case.

criteria.name: Voice match
criteria.notes: Analytical, structural, Alaska-first, business-literate, no banned phrases, no influencer cadence.

criteria.name: Readability (LinkedIn)
criteria.notes: 423 words in range, under 3000 chars, tight paragraphs, single 5-item bullet block.

criteria.name: Engagement question
criteria.notes: Real debatable question tied directly to the chokepoint. No CTA.
